meta.title: Plugin Manager
meta.description: Install, remove, and update dsh plugins from Settings.

en.confirmUninstallHint: Click again to confirm; this cannot be undone
en.forceUninstallHint: Remove directly, bypassing the publish cooldown — for when the official uninstall is blocked by it
en.reliefHintOff: While this profile holds a version published within the last 24 hours, every official-page plugin operation is refused by the release-cooldown audit of pnpm. Enabling writes minimumReleaseAge: 0 into this profile, restoring the official page at once.
en.reliefHintOn: Release-cooldown enforcement is disabled for this profile (minimumReleaseAge: 0). Click to restore the default 24-hour supply-chain hold.
en.restartTrayTitle: Restart the client via Restart Service in the desktop tray menu
